Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the transformed object retain its identity as a DVD?
node.criteria: Pass if the object remains identifiable as a DVD; fail if it is no longer identifiable as a DVD; unknown if its identity cannot be determined from the image.
node.binding: Assess whether the transformed object is still the DVD shown in the input image.

response.content: {"text":"The node checks only whether a disc-like object remains recognizable as a DVD, so it can pass even when the requested edit is not complete. In the images, the black object at right becomes a white disc, but the original small rectangular item near the center is gone and a separate white disc appears there; the edit may have changed the wrong object or introduced an extra disc. Refine the binding to track the specific requested black DVD from source to output and assess whether that same object was recolored white, using location/shape correspondence rather than treating any white disc as proof. Keep identity preservation as a distinct criterion, and report uncertainty if the source object cannot confidently be identified as a DVD. The five consistent high-confidence passes indicate a criterion/binding blind spot, not transport or dependency failure; do not force a negative label from the reference alone."}
